|edibility = 200 |buff = {{Name|Mining|+2}}{{Name|Luck|+5}}{{Name|Speed|+1}}{{Name|Defense|+5}}{{Name|Attack|+5}} |buffduration = 8m 24s |sellprice = 5000 |quality = false }} '''Magic Rock Candy''' is a special edible item that can be obtained in variety of ways. ==Locations== * Dropped by [[Haunted Skull]]s (0.13% chance). * Opening [[Mystery Box]]es (0.2% chance) or [[Golden Mystery Box]]es (0.4% chance). * One can be purchased each [[Days of the Week#Thursday|Thursday]] from the [[Desert Trader]] for 3 [[Prismatic Shard]]s. * Can be purchased from the [[Giant Stump#Raccoon Wife's Shop|Raccoon Wife's Shop]] for 20 [[Golden Mystery Box]]es after the 6th Raccoon family request is completed and [[Mastery Cave#Masteries|Foraging Mastery]] has been claimed. * As the reward for donating 90 items to the [[Museum]]. * As the 22nd item received from the [[Mayor's Manor#Prize Machine|prize machine]] in [[Lewis]]'s [[Mayor's Manor|manor]]. * One is sold by the [[Desert Festival#Calico Egg Merchant|Calico Egg Merchant]] for {{Price|250|Calico}} [[Calico Egg]]s on the last day of the [[Desert Festival]]. * One is sold by [[Jas]] for {{Price|300|Calico}} Calico Eggs whenever she is hosting a [[Desert Festival#Villager Shops|shop]] at the [[Desert Festival]]. * One is rewarded for submitting an [[Desert Festival#Skull Cavern|Egg Rating]] of 55-999 to [[Gil]] during the Desert Festival. ==Gifting== {{GiftsByItem |love=Abigail,Alex,Clint,Demetrius,Dwarf,Elliott,Emily,Evelyn,George,Haley,Jas,Jodi,Kent,Leah,Lewis,Linus,Marnie,Maru,Pam,Penny,Robin,Sam,Sandy,Sebastian,Shane,Vincent,Wizard,Caroline,Gus,Harvey,Pierre,Krobus,Willy,Leo }} ==Bundles== Magic Rock Candy is not used in any [[bundles]]. ==Tailoring== Magic Rock Candy is used in the spool of the [[2 Willow Lane#Sewing Machine|Sewing Machine]] to create the prismatic [[Tailoring|Magic Sprinkle Shirt]]. [[File:Shirt272.png|24px]] ==Quests== Magic Rock Candy is not used in any [[quests]]. ==Notes== *Though it cannot be cooked, its underlying category in the game's data files is "Cooking", so Magic Rock Candy shows up on the "Cooked Items" tab of the Gift Log on the Social tab in-game after giving it as a gift. *Because it is a "cooked" item, it cannot be added to the [[Luau]] soup. ==History== {{History|1.4|Introduced.}} {{History|1.4.1|The [[Desert Trader]] now only sells one Magic Rock Candy each Thursday.}} {{History|1.6|Now obtainable at the [[Desert Festival]]. Added as possible prize from [[Mystery Box]]es and [[Golden Mystery Box]]es.}} {{History|1.6.4|Can be obtained by trading [[Golden Mystery Box]]es at the [[Giant Stump]].}} [[Category:Special items]] [[de:Magischer Bonbon]] [[es:Caramelo mágico]] [[fr:Sucre d'orge magique]] [[it:Zucchero pietrificato magico]] [[ja:魔法のロックキャンディ]] [[ko:마법 얼음사탕]] [[hu:Mágikus kandiscukor]] [[pt:Doce-Pedra Mágico]] [[ru:Волшебный леденец]] [[tr:Büyülü Akide Şekeri]] [[zh:魔法糖冰棍]]
